extra.model_essay: 参考范文 As is depicted in the cartoon, a man who is sitting in front of a computer browsing information tells his wife that he feels unfortunate to live in a world with so much misleading information. Simple as the drawing is, it is absolutely thought-provoking. There is no denying the fact that the Internet has brought us great convenience and efficiency in acquiring information. However, in an age flooded with information, there is a vast amount of misleading information that can do harm to our life and society. For one thing, decisions based on misleading information may result in ill consequences. Companies may adopt a wrong strategy and individuals may make a regrettable choice. For another, false and misleading information may lead to trust crisis, which impairs people's trust in authorities and the mutual trust among people. In view of the seriousness of the problem, it is high time that government departments tightened up their supervision and administration over the online release of information. Meanwhile, we individuals would be wise to develop critical thinking and learn to judge in a rational way. Only in this way can we better the environment of the virtual world and benefit most from the development of technology. 英语六级写作参考译文 ：

extra.model_essay: 参考范文 As we can see from the picture, a man tells his friend that he loves reading and he spends much time every day on Facebook- not a "real" book but a social networking website. Funny as it may seem, it reveals that the Internet has exerted a huge influence on people's reading nowadays. There is no doubt that the Internet offers abundant reading materials and information, which can broaden our horizon and benefit us. However, excessive reading online does have an adverse impact. For one thing, materials and information on the websites can be fragmentary and misleading. Lacking of context, those contents are defective and thus may lead to illogical and even wrong ideas, which apparently impairs our understanding and judgment. For another, people who do reading on the Internet tend to be easily distracted and may end up being obsessed with social networking, while traditional reading, which is essential to acquire true spiritual wealth, gradually gives way. To sum up, it is vital that we, as a college student, adopt a wise attitude toward ways of reading. We should bear in mind that traditional reading still plays a significant role in modem society and cannot be replaced by online reading.

Accordingly, the medication has been divided into branches and doctors and experts in this area have to update their knowledge and put it into practice in order to cure these similar diseases. It is not an uncommon theory that talents tend to be equated with success. However, those who are considered talented may become conceited and lack the motivation to work hard. Obviously, Einstein was well aware of the limitation of talents since he attributed his success to curiosity. The same can be applied to other successful people such as Jack Ma, the founder of Alibaba Group. Jack Ma, who can be said to be equally curious about the future of e-commerce, has worked with persistence over the years to build a business empire which can be comparable to its foreign rivals such as Amazon. In his case, it is curiosity that pushed him to make sustained efforts and enabled him to identify new business models that may seem unimaginable to other people. In a word, Einstein's remark is a valuable reminder for all of those who want the key to success. 英语六级写作参考译文 ： 2015年0 6 月大学英语六级写作第3 套参考范文 When talking about leading a successful life, many people would say it is the great things one has done that make his life meaningful. Just as a proverb goes, “If you cannot do great things, do small things in a great way ” Many cases in point could be cited to support this view. As a plain conductor, Li Suli's main duty was to repeat the routines of selling tickets and informing passengers of bus-stop names. But she never stopped making efforts to learn more about different passengers7 needs or to provide them with good service and useful help. When we are having family gatherings on Chinese New Year's Eve, many electricians are on duty to guarantee electric supply, and many doctors are still on call in case any emergency happens. They sacrifice their holiday time to ensure that more people can enjoy the happiness of family reunion. In a word, there is not a clear-cut line between great things and small things. People who perform their responsibilities seriously or sacrifice their own benefits to make more people happy are all great, no matter how small the things they work on are. 英语六级写作参考译文 ：

extra.topic_prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay commenting on the saying “Never go out there to see what happens, go out there to make things happen.” You can cite examples to illustrate the importance of being participants rather than mere onlookers in life. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
extra.model_essay: There is a saying which goes that “Never go out there to see what happens, go out there to make things happen" Those who did something great and go down in history, ancient and modern, Chinese and foreign, are all doers rather than onlookers. A telling example is Thomas Edison. Without his continuous experiments, he would not have invented so many devices that have greatly influenced people's life around the world, including the phonograph, the motion picture camera, and of course, the long-lasting, practical electric light bulb. However, nowadays it is common to see people just stand aside and keep complaining but be reluctant to participate. In terms of environmental protection, for instance, many people living in big cities complain that the frequent heavy haze pollution messes them up. But they still drive their private cars to destinations rather than taking public transportation. Another case is that some people admire others5 firm abdominal muscles but refuse to take regular exercises. In a word, if we don't take action, nothing will happen. So lefs just go out there to make things happen now. 2015年0 6 月大学英语四级写作范文第1 套 As is vividly depicted in the picture, computers are everywhere in the modern life: in the office, at home, in places for relaxation, even in our dreams. Apparently, the picture reveals the fact that we tend to spend an increasingly large amount of time using computers and, in turn, computers seem to consume a huge part of our daily life. The past two decades has witnessed the rapid development of computers. Unlike 20 years ago when computers were only used on a small scale, computers are now widely used almost in all walks of life to facilitate both our work and life. However, overusing computers may have negative effects on us. First of all, indulging in using computers will deprive us of time with people we care about, leading to a lack of real-time interpersonal communication. Moreover, keeping using computers all day long will definitely do harm to our physical health. In my opinion, although computers play an essential role in our modern life, only when we use them in a moderate way can we live a healthier and more meaningful life. 2015年0 6 月大学英语四级写作范文第2 套 As is shown in the picture, a boy is about to go to school with a school bag on his back and a mobile phone in his hand. However, his father, who is standing beside him, looks rather surprised when the boy asks, “Why am I going to school if my phone already knows everything?^^ Obviously, the boy's understanding of going to school is quite different from his father5s expectation. On the one hand, the boy's question reflects the blurred boundary of education in the digital era. With knowledge easily accessible via smart phones, it is natural for the boy to question the role of school. On the other hand, his question also highlights the urgent need to help children learn by interacting with people instead of using machines. Exposed to digital gadgets since their birth, modern children need to receive education in an interactive environment where they can work and socialize with their classmates. In a word, the function of school will never be replaced by smart phones. What we need to do is to make school more appealing to students. 英语四级写作范文 ： 2015年0 6 月大学英语四级写作范文第3 套 As is vividly depicted in the picture above, a teenage daughter told her mother excitedly that she was granted admission to the college of her mother's choice. Simple as the picture is, the symbolic meaning of it is thought-provoking. Obviously, the picture revealed the fact that modern parents tend to make decisions for their children and children are accustomed to relying on their parents. In my point of view, too much interference with children's growth is not as helpful as it is meant to be. First of all, children are deprived of the opportunities to think carefully and deeply due to their parents5 too much involvement. As a result, children will never know how to make decisions on their own when they grow up. Secondly, over protection can destroy children's curiosity as well as creativity for they are quite used to accepting what their parents have arranged for them. To sum up, too much parents5 interference can be too much of a good thing. Parents should let their children think and decide by themselves. Only in this way can children learn to be independent and become outstanding. 英语四级写作范文 ：

extra.topic_prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay commenting on the saying "Seek to understand others,and you will be understood ". You can cite examples to illustrate your views. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200.
extra.model_essay: 参考范文 As an old saying goes, "Treat others the way you want to be treated.,7 Likewise, if you want to be understood, you must first seek to understand others. To understand others is to put yourself in others' shoes and to be aware of their feelings. That is often perceived as a mere selfless act; but in fact, when you seek to be empathetic, you can melt an otherwise cold relationship and thus are more likely to get understood. If clinicians, for instance, treat patients like medical conditions, not people, then minor disagreements between them may escalate into greater conflicts. On the contrary, if a care provider can put himself in patients' place, trying to feel their pains and sufferings, the patients will be more inclined to understand the clinician, even if the treatment falls flat. In conclusion, understanding generates within us love and inclusiveness. Only when we attempt to understand others, can we truly care about them and tolerate differences. It's understanding that enables us to have a generous heart to be considerate and benevolent. If everyone is willing to do so, we will surely be better understood and tolerated.

But at any rate, it is inadvisable to be distracted by personal interests at work or to be a workaholic.

extra.topic_prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on why students should be encouraged to develop creativity.You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
extra.model_essay: 参考范文 Creativity tends to be considered as an ability with which only a few people are endowed. In fact, it can be taught, practiced and developed. Unfortunately, the conventional teaching method focuses on convergent instead of divergent thinking. Simply put, students are always asked to solve problems that have one correct and well-established answer rather than come up with multiple solutions to open-ended questions. Such neglect of developing creativity will hamper students5 career growth. As everyone knows, creative minds are able to think out of the box. By making novel, original or even unorthodox suggestions, they often act as a savior of a team stuck on a tricky problem. It is no wonder that creativity is one of the soft skills employers value most. Furthermore, lack of this ability may have an adverse effect on students5 mental health. That is because creativity goes a long way to equipping them for the real world characterized by rapid changes. It allows them to look at difficulties and frustrations from a fresh perspective, so that they can live with and adapt to the unknown. To sum up, a creative person has a competitive edge over other job candidates and is more likely to keep composure amid uncertainties. School education should therefore lay more emphasis on fostering creativity among students.

Such radiance from the inside out can not only help increase personal charisma, but also bring hope and warmth to others. That is why people of lofty character always command wide respect, no matter whether they look gorgeous or not. Despite the bruises and marks the protective masks left on their faces, they have been praised as heroes in harm's way fbr their selfless dedication to public health. Therefore, we must bear in mind that genuine beauty is found in our character rather than our external appearance. And to attain a beautiful soul, it is crucial to strive fbr self-improvement and enjoy doing good deeds. 英语六级写作参考译文 ： 2020年0 9 月大学英语六级写作第2 套参考范文 There are countless things we want to do in our lifetime. Just as the saying goes, what is worth doing is worth doing well. Why this saying makes sense is simple: something worth doing must be rewarding. To put it another way, doing it well will eventually pay 。@ no matter economically, emotionally or intellectually. For example, fulfilling our responsibilities at work may seem like a daily routine. But in fact, it means much more than that. Doing our job well not only rewards us with a decent salary, which helps us manage our life and support our family, but also gives us a sense of accomplishment. This is why we should take it seriously and try to do it well. 2020年0 9 月大学英语六级写作第3 套参考范文 Modern life is characterized by packed agendas. While it is true that high efficiency is important in generating economic wealth, its damage to people's psychological well-being is increasingly worrying. In a time when mental health problems such as burnout and depression become more and more common, we need to remind ourselves of that cliched yet compelling saving: wealth of the mind is the only true wealth. Admittedly, having adequate economic wealth is a prerequisite for a carefree life. But an overemphasis on it has opposite effects. It exhausts our mental energy and distracts us from pursuing what makes us truly happy. To live a genuinely fulfilling life, we should instead focus on building wealth of the mind. This does not mean we all should dedicate ourselves to creating cultural wealth as artists do. Instead, all activities that contribute to our mental well-being add to wealth of the mind. Following this logic, even taking a walk in the garden, which helps relieve stress and anxiety, can increase wealth of the mind. In our current social context, economic wealth is regarded as the primary sign of success. It is high time we changed that and shifted our focus to wealth of the mind. 英语六级写作参考译文 ： 2020年0 7 月大学英语六级写作全1 套参考范文 While we all desire to lead an ideal life someday, not many of us take practical actions to realize it. Some may excuse themselves by claiming that they are not ready to get started. As a matter of fact, they have yet to grasp the truth of that saying: the best preparation for tomorrow is doing your best today. While tomorrow is unpredictable, today is to a large extent manageable. This means that a constant fbcus on tomorrow is futile, but due attention paid to today will bear fruit. Take physical training as an example. If you want to improve your physical fitness, the most effective way is to start now rather than spend hours making complicated workout plans for the following weeks. It is not that planning is of little value. It is just that people are inclined to indulge in the illusory satisfaction from planning, and it often holds them back from taking immediate actions. It is very difficult to shake off our inertia. Only by confronting it and acting now can we move toward success. Those who put off what really matters to them until tomorrow will end up achieving nothing.

extra.model_essay: 参考范文 The Internet should have served as a repository of trustworthy resources. But unfortunately, it has become an ideal breeding ground fbr fake news and false information. This is an issue to be reckoned with, given the sheer number of Internet users. Viral rumors, if left unchecked, may trigger unnecessary panic and irrational behavior. This was the case in early March of 2020, when consumers in many countries stripped supermarket shelves bare of toilet paper after being misled into believing it would be in short supply as a consequence of the COVID-19 outbreak. Even worse, medical misinformation circulating online can be life- threatening, as evidenced by increased infections due to widespread anti-vaccine conspiracy theories amid this pandemic. A multi-pronged approach is needed to combat misinformation. First, journalists and would-be journalists should all be warned not to violate professional ethics. Second, regulatory agencies must impose harsh punishments on individuals profiting from fake news as well as online platforms turning a blind eye to it. Above all, the general public must learn to identify credible sources of information, rather than take every social media post at face value and jump to conclusions before knowing the whole story.

This was the case in early March of 2020, when consumers in many countries stripped supermarket shelves bare of toilet paper after being misled into believing it would be in short supply as a consequence of the COVID-19 outbreak. Even worse, medical misinformation circulating online can be life- threatening, as evidenced by increased infections due to widespread anti-vaccine conspiracy theories amid this pandemic. A multi-pronged approach is needed to combat misinformation. First, journalists and would-be journalists should all be warned not to violate professional ethics. Second, regulatory agencies must impose harsh punishments on individuals profiting from fake news as well as online platforms turning a blind eye to it. Above all, the general public must learn to identify credible sources of information, rather than take every social media post at face value and jump to conclusions before knowing the whole story.

Specifically, the share of its urban population passed the 60 percent mark in 2019, more than three times the proportion in 1980. Better living conditions have immensely enhanced urban dwellers5 sense of well-being. Moreover, urban growth and prosperity have opened up a wider range of employment opportunities, attracting a rising number of rural residents to cities in pursuit of a higher quality of life. Such mass migration has been further facilitated by heavy investment in transport infrastructure and the consequent rapid expansion of China's road and rail networks. Long-distance travel from remote villages to major cities has never been so accessible and affordable. China's accomplishments in urbanization are undeniably noteworthy and significant. The reasons for this stunning achievement are manifold. To begin with, China's booming economy over this period has substantially improved people's living standards and enabled families to invest more in kids' education. Placing a high priority on fostering an educated workforce, the government has been pursuing measures to expand educational opportunities, such as opening more higher education institutions and subsidizing tuition. Moreover, Chinese culture, which attaches great value to education following the Confucian tradition, has also contributed to this remarkable progress. One of the direct beneficiaries of this achievement is each individual student. These encouraging figures mark the country's complete victory in its fight against poverty. Such remarkable achievements owe a great deal to the government's policy support. In recent years, China has implemented the targeted poverty alleviation strategy, tailoring relief plans for each poverty-stricken village or even household. These specially designed measures, ranging from infrastructure improvements to industrial development, lay a solid foundation for eradicating poverty and building a moderately well-off society in all respects. At the same time, various social sectors have got involved by introducing new business models such as e-commerce and tourism to rural areas. This has injected fresh impetus into the local economy. Moreover, individual efforts constitute another crucial factor in getting rid of poverty, as evidenced by the stories of numerous underprivileged rural students changing their future through hard work. Just as President Xi once put it, being lifted out of poverty is not an end in itself but the starting point of a new life and a new pursuit. The Chinese people will continue to strive for common prosperity with strong determination and concerted efforts. 英语六级写作参考译文 ：

extra.model_essay: 参考范文 The Importance of Developing the Ability to Think Critically In an era of information explosion, it is vitally important to develop the ability to think critically and make rational choices. In today's world, we have access to vast amounts of information, data, facts and research than ever before, which may be a blessing to some, but a nightmare to others. A key factor in managing such information overload is the ability to use critical thinking skills. For one thing, critical thinking skills are crucial to making well-informed decisions in an age of information overload and fake news. Making a decision solely on the basis of emotion or gut instinct can result in unhealthy lifestyles, dire financial circumstances or unsound investments. Critical thinking, on the other hand, facilitates the development of informed, healthy decisions based on facts rather than faulty assumptions and also assists in sorting through extra noise. For another, being able to think critically will define one as a problem solver, who can see things from multiple perspectives and come up with creative solutions that others may not have considered. To sum up, it is important to develop critical thinking skills so that we can form informed opinions and set ourselves apart from our peers in a competitive environment.

I fully agree with this view since elderly people outperform young people in skills and experience and with these advantages they can still contribute a lot to society. Firstly, elderly people, with their expertise and rich experience can do better than young people in many fields. Lefs take an example of education, Elderly teachers in school, with years of teaching experience, know better how to inspire students and they are good at teaching students in accordance with their aptitude. Young teachers still need to learn teaching skills under the elderly teachers7 expert guidance. Thus, elderly teachers can make great contributions towards education. Furthermore, elderly people can deal with difficult problems. For example, facing cases with complicated symptoms, elderly doctors can make accurate diagnosis thanks to their professional skills and rich experience. And young doctors have a lot to learn from those elderly doctors. Therefore, elderly doctors play an important role in medical care. To sum up, elderly people can continue to make great contributions to society with their valuable skills and experience. They can play an active role in various fields of the society. 2023年0 6 月大学英语六级写作第1 套参考范文 Today there is a growing awareness that mental well being needs to be given as much attention as physical health. This idea should be embraced by more people, especially in a time when mental illnesses such as depression and anxiety disorder become more prevalent. Mental health is of vital importance, as it will exert a profound influence on every aspect of our lives. An unhealthy mind can cause a persistent feeling of sadness and loss of interest in things we once enjoyed. Over time, such negative emotions will overwhelm us to the point where we cannot carry on with even the most basic tasks. In contrast, when we are in good mental health, we tend to find joy in daily life and thus experience a sense of happiness. This also helps increase our resilience, which means we can be mentally strong enough to bounce back from setbacks and rise to new challenges. In summary, we should put as much emphasis on our mental health as we do on physical health. To keep mentally fit, we should not only try our best to stay positive, but also learn to seek professional help if necessary. Furthermore, collective efforts are needed to create a more inclusive social environment, where no one has to suffer the stigma of having mental problems any longer. 英语六级写作参考译文 ： 2023年0 6 月大学英语六级写作第2 套参考范文 When faced with differing opinions, we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument. These two approaches play distinct roles in reconciling different views and building consensus. To begin with,being friendly and respectful helps prevent a minor disagreement from escalating into a bitter dispute, which is essential for effective communication. For instance, calm discussions on topics such as parenting styles or financial decisions enable family members to understand each other's perspectives and seek compromises acceptable to all sides. Meanwhile, reasonable argument allows for the clear and logical presentation of thoughts and opinions, leading to more convincing conclusions. This is particularly vital in professional settings, where there are often diverse problem solving approaches to a problem. Members of a work team need to evaluate the strengths and weaknesses of each proposal rationally and thoroughly before arriving at an agreed final decision. To create an atmosphere of amiable discussion and rational debate, both schools and society have crucial roles to play. Schools can develop curricula that foster students7 habits of friendly conversations and equip them with logical argumentation skills. On the other hand, society can provide more platforms for individuals from diverse backgrounds to discuss controversial issues and make constructive comments. 2023年0 6 月大学英语六级写作第3 套参考范文 It is widely accepted that an important goal of education is to help students learn how to learn. While the accumulation of knowledge is undoubtedly crucial, it is the capacity to acquire, assimilate, and apply information that truly benefits individuals throughout their lives. For one thing, the world is constantly evolving, with new information and ideas emerging at a rapid pace. The ability to learn equips students with the necessary skills to keep pace with these changes. For another, developing learning capacity promotes problem-solving skills and fosters creativity. Memorization often follows a fixed pattern, restricting students5 ability to think outside the box. Conversely, when students are empowered to learn, they acquire the skills to think critically and approach challenges with creative solutions. Moreover, students who are taught how to learn can develop a curiosity for new knowledge, thereby becoming a lifelong learner. In conclusion,the focus of education should be shifted from imparting knowledge to cultivating learning skills in students. To achieve this goal, educators should fbcus on teaching key learning strategies, such as goal-setting and self assessment. They can also foster a love for learning by allowing students to explore their interests and providing opportunities fbr independent and collaborative learning. 英语六级写作参考译文 ： 2023年0 3 月大学英语六级写作第1 套参考范文 People are now increasingly aware of the danger of "appearance anxiety“ or being obsessed with one's looks. Such anxiety will take a heavy toll on people's physical and mental health. Many young adults report feeling unhappy with their appearance, and they may go to great lengths to achieve the “ideal“ body image portrayed in the media. For example,some of them opt for extreme dieting, and some choose to undergo high-risk plastic surgery. However, instead of being satisfied, they may end up becoming overly preoccupied with flaws in their appearance that are often unnoticeable or appear minor to others. This will without doubt lead to low self-esteem or even feelings of shame and depression. Fortunately, with the growing awareness of the detrimental effect of appearance anxiety, the public has begun to make a change. By embracing diversity and inclusion in beauty standards, people try to appreciate their own uniqueness, rather than constantly compare their body to others. In addition, they realize that beauty is not simply defined by external looks, and therefore shift their focus to inner qualities- the very thing that increases personal charm. 2023年0 3 月大学英语六级写作第2 套参考范文 People are now increasingly aware of the challenges in making a decision when faced with too many choices. With an explosion of options in virtually every field, ranging from the products we buy to the schools we attend, decision-making has become more complicated than ever before. For instance, consider the task of selecting a restaurant for dinner. Some people may spend hours searching for the perfect place by scrolling through online restaurant reviews and menus. This process is problematic as it can lead to analysis paralysis, where too many options result in. no decision being made at all. Moreover, choosing a suitable career path can be even more stressful. Before making their final decision, individuals have to take into account a wide variety of factors such as, whether a career aligns with their passions and interests and whether an industry has a promising future. Many of them may end up being confused, overwhelmed and hesitant due to the sheer number of career choices and the need to weigh up the pros and cons of each choice. To combat decision-making dilemmas, people must make adequate use of available resources to help them make informed decisions quickly. Rather than trying to analyze every option, individuals can simplify the process by prioritizing their needs? setting clear criteria, and limiting their choices. 英语六级写作参考译文 ： 2023年0 3 月大学英语六级写作第3 套参考范文 People are now increasingly aware of the 'digital gap' or challenges the elderly face in a digital world. The wide application of digital technology is meant to make life easier and better, but unfortunately, it has caused inconvenience to older generations. Unlike young people who have grown up with digital technology? the vast majority of seniors are unfamiliar with computers and smartphones. It takes much more time and effort for them to acquire digital skills, which puts them at a disadvantage as almost everything is moving online. For example, they may be refused access to some tourist attractions if they haven't reserved tickets online in advance. In addition, their lack of digital literacy makes themselves particularly vulnerable to misinformation spread on social media. Even worse, some of them may fall victim to cyber scams, suffering a substantial loss of wealth. What can we do, then, to help bridge the digital divide? First, tech companies should develop products or apps tailored to meet the requirements of elderly people. Second, there should be digital literacy training for seniors, as well as strict rules and regulations to ensure the availability of services such as selling tickets offline. Finally, and perhaps most importan ly, we need to treat the elderly in a more patient and understanding way when they run into problems using digital devices.

Some people hold the view that social practice plays an indispensable role in education, while others believe that it is not necessary for everyone to be involved in social activities. For me, I agree with the former. Firstly, social practice can help complement academic learning. Through social practice, students can not only apply what they have learned in real-life situations, enhancing their understanding, but also get inspiration, which is useful for their academic learning. Secondly, social practice is beneficial to fostering teamwork, which is of great importance for the future job. Social practice exposes students to cooperation with different people. It is conceivable that only when students cooperate can they finish the task. Lastly, social practice makes students face different challenges. It encourages them to think critically and creatively to find solutions. This not only enriches their learning experience but also prepares them for their future roles in society. All in all, knowledge and action should go hand in hand. Social practice and academic learning are of equal importance, which is the key to producing well-rounded individuals.

You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.
extra.model_essay: 参考范文 The Roles of Realistic Goals and Persistence in Achieving Success To increase the likelihood of success, one should set realistic goals and work persistently towards them. Setting realistic goals ensures that our aspirations are attainable, while persistence helps us stay on track despite inevitable challenges. For one thing, realistic goals are crucial because they are grounded in our current abilities, resources and circumstances. For instance, when a student decides to improve his grades, setting a goal of ten points increase on average in the next semester is more feasible than an aim of straight A's. A goal that is too ambitious might lead to discouragement if it is unmet, while one that is realistic offers a sense of accomplishment and progress. For another, persistence is key to overcoming setbacks and maintaining motivation. The path to success is often not a smooth one; there will be obstacles and moments of doubt. Take the story of Thomas Edison for example. He failed thousands of times before inventing the light bulb, but his persistence eventually bore the fruit of groundbreaking success. In conclusion, setting realistic goals and persistence form the backbone of success. By achieving our goals step by step and working persistently, we can build confidence in overcoming obstacles and eventually achieve greater success.

extra.model_essay: 参考范文 The Importance of Self-discipline in Personal Growth Nowadays, more and more students have realized the importance of self-discipline in their personal growth. As for me, in a world full of distractions, cultivating self-discipline has become increasingly important for achieving academic success, shaping personal characters and addressing challenges. First and foremost, self-discipline is essential for achieving academic success. For instance, a student who practices self-discipline will prioritize studying over unnecessary distractions and avoid cramming at the last minute. In addition to academic benefits, self-discipline also plays a significant role in shaping a student's character and personality. It helps to cultivate valuable life skills such as time management, goal setting, and decision-making, all of which are essential for personal growth. Moreover, students who possess self-discipline are better equipped to handle challenges. In the face of setbacks or failures, self-discipline enables students to keep going, learn from their mistakes, and try again. This will help them build resilience, which will give them lifelong benefits. In conclusion, self-discipline is a vital trait that empowers students to reach their full potential in their personal growth. 英语六级写作参考译文 第 页 ： 4

extra.model_essay: 参考范文 The Journey of Exploration in College College provides a great opportunity for students to explore various possibilities and find the right path for themselves. This period of exploration plays a crucial role in shaping their future. One of the most compelling aspects of college is the opportunity it provides for academic exploration. In college, students have the freedom to choose their courses and create a personalized academic path. This flexibility offers students access to different subjects, which is crucial in helping them identify what they are truly passionate about. Beyond the academic aspect, college also offers students the chance to explore their personal interests through extracurricular activities. Diversified clubs and societies provide countless ways for students to enjoy campus life and develop new interests. Moreover, college also provides opportunities for students to connect with others from diverse backgrounds. These interactions broaden students' perspectives and encourage them to think critically about who they are. To conclude, college is a place not only for academic learning but also for personal exploration. It offers students the freedom to try and make mistakes, and ultimately gives them an opportunity to find who they are and what they really want.

extra.topic_prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay commenting on the saying “Never go out there to see what happens, go out there to make things happen.” You can cite examples to illustrate the importance of being participants rather than mere onlookers in life. extra.model_essay: There is a saying which goes that “Never go out there to see what happens, go out there to make things happen" Those who did something great and go down in history, ancient and modern, Chinese and foreign, are all doers rather than onlookers. A telling example is Thomas Edison. Without his continuous experiments, he would not have invented so many devices that have greatly influenced people's life around the world, including the phonograph, the motion picture camera, and of course, the long-lasting, practical electric light bulb. However, nowadays it is common to see people just stand aside and keep complaining but be reluctant to participate. In terms of environmental protection, for instance, many people living in big cities complain that the frequent heavy haze pollution messes them up. But they still drive their private cars to destinations rather than taking public transportation. Another case is that some people admire others5 firm abdominal muscles but refuse to take regular exercises. In a word, if we don't take action, nothing will happen. So lefs just go out there to make things happen now. 2015年0 6 月大学英语四级写作范文第1 套 As is vividly depicted in the picture, computers are everywhere in the modern life: in the office, at home, in places for relaxation, even in our dreams. Apparently, the picture reveals the fact that we tend to spend an increasingly large amount of time using computers and, in turn, computers seem to consume a huge part of our daily life. The past two decades has witnessed the rapid development of computers. Unlike 20 years ago when computers were only used on a small scale, computers are now widely used almost in all walks of life to facilitate both our work and life. However, overusing computers may have negative effects on us. First of all, indulging in using computers will deprive us of time with people we care about, leading to a lack of real-time interpersonal communication. Moreover, keeping using computers all day long will definitely do harm to our physical health. In my opinion, although computers play an essential role in our modern life, only when we use them in a moderate way can we live a healthier and more meaningful life. 2015年0 6 月大学英语四级写作范文第2 套 As is shown in the picture, a boy is about to go to school with a school bag on his back and a mobile phone in his hand. However, his father, who is standing beside him, looks rather surprised when the boy asks, “Why am I going to school if my phone already knows everything?^^ Obviously, the boy's understanding of going to school is quite different from his father5s expectation. On the one hand, the boy's question reflects the blurred boundary of education in the digital era. With knowledge easily accessible via smart phones, it is natural for the boy to question the role of school. On the other hand, his question also highlights the urgent need to help children learn by interacting with people instead of using machines. Exposed to digital gadgets since their birth, modern children need to receive education in an interactive environment where they can work and socialize with their classmates. In a word, the function of school will never be replaced by smart phones. What we need to do is to make school more appealing to students. 英语四级写作范文 ： 2015年0 6 月大学英语四级写作范文第3 套 As is vividly depicted in the picture above, a teenage daughter told her mother excitedly that she was granted admission to the college of her mother's choice. Simple as the picture is, the symbolic meaning of it is thought-provoking. Obviously, the picture revealed the fact that modern parents tend to make decisions for their children and children are accustomed to relying on their parents. In my point of view, too much interference with children's growth is not as helpful as it is meant to be. First of all, children are deprived of the opportunities to think carefully and deeply due to their parents5 too much involvement. As a result, children will never know how to make decisions on their own when they grow up. Secondly, over protection can destroy children's curiosity as well as creativity for they are quite used to accepting what their parents have arranged for them. To sum up, too much parents5 interference can be too much of a good thing. Parents should let their children think and decide by themselves. Only in this way can children learn to be independent and become outstanding. 英语四级写作范文 ：

extra.topic_prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay commenting on the saying "Seek to understand others,and you will be understood ". You can cite examples to illustrate your views. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200.
extra.model_essay: 参考范文 As an old saying goes, "Treat others the way you want to be treated.,7 Likewise, if you want to be understood, you must first seek to understand others. To understand others is to put yourself in others' shoes and to be aware of their feelings. That is often perceived as a mere selfless act; but in fact, when you seek to be empathetic, you can melt an otherwise cold relationship and thus are more likely to get understood. If clinicians, for instance, treat patients like medical conditions, not people, then minor disagreements between them may escalate into greater conflicts. In conclusion, understanding generates within us love and inclusiveness. Only when we attempt to understand others, can we truly care about them and tolerate differences. It's understanding that enables us to have a generous heart to be considerate and benevolent. If everyone is willing to do so, we will surely be better understood and tolerated.

extra.model_essay: 参考范文 Creativity tends to be considered as an ability with which only a few people are endowed. In fact, it can be taught, practiced and developed. Unfortunately, the conventional teaching method focuses on convergent instead of divergent thinking. Simply put, students are always asked to solve problems that have one correct and well-established answer rather than come up with multiple solutions to open-ended questions. Such neglect of developing creativity will hamper students5 career growth. As everyone knows, creative minds are able to think out of the box. By making novel, original or even unorthodox suggestions, they often act as a savior of a team stuck on a tricky problem. It is no wonder that creativity is one of the soft skills employers value most. Furthermore, lack of this ability may have an adverse effect on students5 mental health. That is because creativity goes a long way to equipping them for the real world characterized by rapid changes. It allows them to look at difficulties and frustrations from a fresh perspective, so that they can live with and adapt to the unknown. To sum up, a creative person has a competitive edge over other job candidates and is more likely to keep composure amid uncertainties. School education should therefore lay more emphasis on fostering creativity among students.

Therefore, it is especially important for us students to cultivate the ability to meet challenges. When running into daunting challenges, many of us will almost instinctively shy away from them, reluctant or frightened to step out of our comfort zone. This passive approach could easily hinder us from making progress. On the contrary, if we pluck up the courage to challenge ourselves, we may reap the rewards even of failure. As German philosopher Friedrich Nietzsche said, “what doesn't kill me makes me stronger.,, Confronting challenges and striving to navigate through them help us build resilience and mental strength. This will in turn lay a solid foundation for our success in the future, because the ability to take on challenges is a prerequisite for realizing our full potential and achieving significant breakthroughs. We have no other choice than to equip ourselves with the determination and ability to meet and overcome challenges. 2020年0 9 月大学英语六级写作第1 套参考范文 “Beauty of the soul is the essential beauty " In other words, the true beauty of a person comes from within, from his or her virtues. This saying is quite thought-provoking for many of today's young adults who are obsessed with physical appearance. Outer beauty, to be sure, is not insignificant, but it will eventually fade with age. Inner beauty, on the other hand, lasts forever and even has the potential to get more radiant with time. Such radiance from the inside out can not only help increase personal charisma, but also bring hope and warmth to others. That is why people of lofty character always command wide respect, no matter whether they look gorgeous or not. Take the medical staff who have risked their lives to battle the novel coronavirus in the front line as an example. Despite the bruises and marks the protective masks left on their faces, they have been praised as heroes in harm's way fbr their selfless dedication to public health. Therefore, we must bear in mind that genuine beauty is found in our character rather than our external appearance. And to attain a beautiful soul, it is crucial to strive fbr self-improvement and enjoy doing good deeds. 英语六级写作参考译文 ： 2020年0 9 月大学英语六级写作第2 套参考范文 There are countless things we want to do in our lifetime. We may argue over which are worth doing and which are not, but the undisputed principle is that as long as the thing in question is worth doing, we must do it well. Just as the saying goes, what is worth doing is worth doing well. Why this saying makes sense is simple: something worth doing must be rewarding. To put it another way, doing it well will eventually pay 。@ no matter economically, emotionally or intellectually. For example, fulfilling our responsibilities at work may seem like a daily routine. But in fact, it means much more than that. Doing our job well not only rewards us with a decent salary, which helps us manage our life and support our family, but also gives us a sense of accomplishment. Through our work, we get the feeling that we are an indispensable member of this society and that our contributions matter. In short, if something deserves our efforts, it will be beneficial one way or another. This is why we should take it seriously and try to do it well. 2020年0 9 月大学英语六级写作第3 套参考范文 Modern life is characterized by packed agendas. While it is true that high efficiency is important in generating economic wealth, its damage to people's psychological well-being is increasingly worrying. In a time when mental health problems such as burnout and depression become more and more common, we need to remind ourselves of that cliched yet compelling saving: wealth of the mind is the only true wealth. Admittedly, having adequate economic wealth is a prerequisite for a carefree life. But an overemphasis on it has opposite effects. It exhausts our mental energy and distracts us from pursuing what makes us truly happy. To live a genuinely fulfilling life, we should instead focus on building wealth of the mind. This does not mean we all should dedicate ourselves to creating cultural wealth as artists do. Instead, all activities that contribute to our mental well-being add to wealth of the mind. Following this logic, even taking a walk in the garden, which helps relieve stress and anxiety, can increase wealth of the mind. In our current social context, economic wealth is regarded as the primary sign of success. It is high time we changed that and shifted our focus to wealth of the mind. 英语六级写作参考译文 ： 2020年0 7 月大学英语六级写作全1 套参考范文 While we all desire to lead an ideal life someday, not many of us take practical actions to realize it. Some may excuse themselves by claiming that they are not ready to get started. As a matter of fact, they have yet to grasp the truth of that saying: the best preparation for tomorrow is doing your best today. While tomorrow is unpredictable, today is to a large extent manageable. This means that a constant fbcus on tomorrow is futile, but due attention paid to today will bear fruit. Take physical training as an example. If you want to improve your physical fitness, the most effective way is to start now rather than spend hours making complicated workout plans for the following weeks. It is not that planning is of little value. It is just that people are inclined to indulge in the illusory satisfaction from planning, and it often holds them back from taking immediate actions. It is very difficult to shake off our inertia. Only by confronting it and acting now can we move toward success. Those who put off what really matters to them until tomorrow will end up achieving nothing.

extra.model_essay: 参考范文 The Internet should have served as a repository of trustworthy resources. But unfortunately, it has become an ideal breeding ground fbr fake news and false information. This is an issue to be reckoned with, given the sheer number of Internet users. Viral rumors, if left unchecked, may trigger unnecessary panic and irrational behavior. This was the case in early March of 2020, when consumers in many countries stripped supermarket shelves bare of toilet paper after being misled into believing it would be in short supply as a consequence of the COVID-19 outbreak. Even worse, medical misinformation circulating online can be life- threatening, as evidenced by increased infections due to widespread anti-vaccine conspiracy theories amid this pandemic. A multi-pronged approach is needed to combat misinformation. First, journalists and would-be journalists should all be warned not to violate professional ethics. Second, regulatory agencies must impose harsh punishments on individuals profiting from fake news as well as online platforms turning a blind eye to it. Above all, the general public must learn to identify credible sources of information, rather than take every social media post at face value and jump to conclusions before knowing the whole story.

Some of them slavishly imitate their idols' appearance and behavior, or even try to make contact with their idols at all costs. It is understandable that teenagers seek to escape from reality and relieve stress through idolizing celebrities. But blind idol worship is by no means sensible. For young students, spending an excessive amount of time supporting their idols distracts them from their schoolwork. Moreover, at an impressionable age, they may easily slip into bad habits and develop false values once their idols fail to act as a role model. For celebrities, extreme fan behavior means an intrusion into their private lives. To tackle this issue requires a concerted effort. First, teenagers should be taught to focus more on their idols, inner qualities than physical appearance. Their parents can help by encouraging them to learn from their idols, achievements and strive fbr higher goals. Second, celebrities should set a positive example fbr teenagers by being well-mannered and doing good deeds. In addition, the mass media need to pay much less attention to show business so as not to mislead the younger generation into believing that the lifestyle of celebrities is the only one worth pursuing. 英语六级写作参考译文 ：

For another, being able to think critically will define one as a problem solver, who can see things from multiple perspectives and come up with creative solutions that others may not have considered. To sum up, it is important to develop critical thinking skills so that we can form informed opinions and set ourselves apart from our peers in a competitive environment.

extra.model_essay: 参考范文 With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society. I fully agree with this view since elderly people outperform young people in skills and experience and with these advantages they can still contribute a lot to society. Firstly, elderly people, with their expertise and rich experience can do better than young people in many fields. Lefs take an example of education, Elderly teachers in school, with years of teaching experience, know better how to inspire students and they are good at teaching students in accordance with their aptitude. Young teachers still need to learn teaching skills under the elderly teachers7 expert guidance. Thus, elderly teachers can make great contributions towards education. Furthermore, elderly people can deal with difficult problems. For example, facing cases with complicated symptoms, elderly doctors can make accurate diagnosis thanks to their professional skills and rich experience. And young doctors have a lot to learn from those elderly doctors. Therefore, elderly doctors play an important role in medical care. To sum up, elderly people can continue to make great contributions to society with their valuable skills and experience. They can play an active role in various fields of the society. 2023年0 6 月大学英语六级写作第1 套参考范文 Today there is a growing awareness that mental well being needs to be given as much attention as physical health. This idea should be embraced by more people, especially in a time when mental illnesses such as depression and anxiety disorder become more prevalent. Mental health is of vital importance, as it will exert a profound influence on every aspect of our lives. An unhealthy mind can cause a persistent feeling of sadness and loss of interest in things we once enjoyed. Over time, such negative emotions will overwhelm us to the point where we cannot carry on with even the most basic tasks. In contrast, when we are in good mental health, we tend to find joy in daily life and thus experience a sense of happiness. This also helps increase our resilience, which means we can be mentally strong enough to bounce back from setbacks and rise to new challenges. In summary, we should put as much emphasis on our mental health as we do on physical health. To keep mentally fit, we should not only try our best to stay positive, but also learn to seek professional help if necessary. Furthermore, collective efforts are needed to create a more inclusive social environment, where no one has to suffer the stigma of having mental problems any longer. 英语六级写作参考译文 ： 2023年0 6 月大学英语六级写作第2 套参考范文 When faced with differing opinions, we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument. These two approaches play distinct roles in reconciling different views and building consensus. To begin with,being friendly and respectful helps prevent a minor disagreement from escalating into a bitter dispute, which is essential for effective communication. For instance, calm discussions on topics such as parenting styles or financial decisions enable family members to understand each other's perspectives and seek compromises acceptable to all sides. Meanwhile, reasonable argument allows for the clear and logical presentation of thoughts and opinions, leading to more convincing conclusions. This is particularly vital in professional settings, where there are often diverse problem solving approaches to a problem. Members of a work team need to evaluate the strengths and weaknesses of each proposal rationally and thoroughly before arriving at an agreed final decision. To create an atmosphere of amiable discussion and rational debate, both schools and society have crucial roles to play. Schools can develop curricula that foster students7 habits of friendly conversations and equip them with logical argumentation skills. On the other hand, society can provide more platforms for individuals from diverse backgrounds to discuss controversial issues and make constructive comments. 2023年0 6 月大学英语六级写作第3 套参考范文 It is widely accepted that an important goal of education is to help students learn how to learn. While the accumulation of knowledge is undoubtedly crucial, it is the capacity to acquire, assimilate, and apply information that truly benefits individuals throughout their lives. For one thing, the world is constantly evolving, with new information and ideas emerging at a rapid pace. The ability to learn equips students with the necessary skills to keep pace with these changes. For another, developing learning capacity promotes problem-solving skills and fosters creativity. Memorization often follows a fixed pattern, restricting students5 ability to think outside the box. Conversely, when students are empowered to learn, they acquire the skills to think critically and approach challenges with creative solutions. Moreover, students who are taught how to learn can develop a curiosity for new knowledge, thereby becoming a lifelong learner. In conclusion,the focus of education should be shifted from imparting knowledge to cultivating learning skills in students. To achieve this goal, educators should fbcus on teaching key learning strategies, such as goal-setting and self assessment. They can also foster a love for learning by allowing students to explore their interests and providing opportunities fbr independent and collaborative learning. 英语六级写作参考译文 ： 2023年0 3 月大学英语六级写作第1 套参考范文 People are now increasingly aware of the danger of "appearance anxiety“ or being obsessed with one's looks. Such anxiety will take a heavy toll on people's physical and mental health. Many young adults report feeling unhappy with their appearance, and they may go to great lengths to achieve the “ideal“ body image portrayed in the media. For example,some of them opt for extreme dieting, and some choose to undergo high-risk plastic surgery. However, instead of being satisfied, they may end up becoming overly preoccupied with flaws in their appearance that are often unnoticeable or appear minor to others. This will without doubt lead to low self-esteem or even feelings of shame and depression. Fortunately, with the growing awareness of the detrimental effect of appearance anxiety, the public has begun to make a change. By embracing diversity and inclusion in beauty standards, people try to appreciate their own uniqueness, rather than constantly compare their body to others. In addition, they realize that beauty is not simply defined by external looks, and therefore shift their focus to inner qualities- the very thing that increases personal charm. 2023年0 3 月大学英语六级写作第2 套参考范文 People are now increasingly aware of the challenges in making a decision when faced with too many choices. With an explosion of options in virtually every field, ranging from the products we buy to the schools we attend, decision-making has become more complicated than ever before. For instance, consider the task of selecting a restaurant for dinner. Some people may spend hours searching for the perfect place by scrolling through online restaurant reviews and menus. This process is problematic as it can lead to analysis paralysis, where too many options result in. no decision being made at all. Moreover, choosing a suitable career path can be even more stressful. Before making their final decision, individuals have to take into account a wide variety of factors such as, whether a career aligns with their passions and interests and whether an industry has a promising future. Many of them may end up being confused, overwhelmed and hesitant due to the sheer number of career choices and the need to weigh up the pros and cons of each choice. To combat decision-making dilemmas, people must make adequate use of available resources to help them make informed decisions quickly. Rather than trying to analyze every option, individuals can simplify the process by prioritizing their needs? setting clear criteria, and limiting their choices. 英语六级写作参考译文 ： 2023年0 3 月大学英语六级写作第3 套参考范文 People are now increasingly aware of the 'digital gap' or challenges the elderly face in a digital world. The wide application of digital technology is meant to make life easier and better, but unfortunately, it has caused inconvenience to older generations. Unlike young people who have grown up with digital technology? the vast majority of seniors are unfamiliar with computers and smartphones. It takes much more time and effort for them to acquire digital skills, which puts them at a disadvantage as almost everything is moving online. For example, they may be refused access to some tourist attractions if they haven't reserved tickets online in advance. In addition, their lack of digital literacy makes themselves particularly vulnerable to misinformation spread on social media. Even worse, some of them may fall victim to cyber scams, suffering a substantial loss of wealth. What can we do, then, to help bridge the digital divide? First, tech companies should develop products or apps tailored to meet the requirements of elderly people. Second, there should be digital literacy training for seniors, as well as strict rules and regulations to ensure the availability of services such as selling tickets offline. Finally, and perhaps most importan ly, we need to treat the elderly in a more patient and understanding way when they run into problems using digital devices.

For example, they may be refused access to some tourist attractions if they haven't reserved tickets online in advance. In addition, their lack of digital literacy makes themselves particularly vulnerable to misinformation spread on social media. Even worse, some of them may fall victim to cyber scams, suffering a substantial loss of wealth. What can we do, then, to help bridge the digital divide? First, tech companies should develop products or apps tailored to meet the requirements of elderly people. Second, there should be digital literacy training for seniors, as well as strict rules and regulations to ensure the availability of services such as selling tickets offline. Finally, and perhaps most importan ly, we need to treat the elderly in a more patient and understanding way when they run into problems using digital devices.

extra.topic_prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “To increase the likelihood of success, one should set realistic goals and work persistently towards them.” You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.
extra.model_essay: 参考范文 The Roles of Realistic Goals and Persistence in Achieving Success To increase the likelihood of success, one should set realistic goals and work persistently towards them. Setting realistic goals ensures that our aspirations are attainable, while persistence helps us stay on track despite inevitable challenges. For one thing, realistic goals are crucial because they are grounded in our current abilities, resources and circumstances. For instance, when a student decides to improve his grades, setting a goal of ten points increase on average in the next semester is more feasible than an aim of straight A's. A goal that is too ambitious might lead to discouragement if it is unmet, while one that is realistic offers a sense of accomplishment and progress. For another, persistence is key to overcoming setbacks and maintaining motivation. The path to success is often not a smooth one; there will be obstacles and moments of doubt. Take the story of Thomas Edison for example. He failed thousands of times before inventing the light bulb, but his persistence eventually bore the fruit of groundbreaking success. In conclusion, setting realistic goals and persistence form the backbone of success. By achieving our goals step by step and working persistently, we can build confidence in overcoming obstacles and eventually achieve greater success.

In conclusion, self-discipline is a vital trait that empowers students to reach their full potential in their personal growth. 英语六级写作参考译文 第 页 ： 4
